description: Reference for the `esm-scen7-h-SST-*` experiments and atmosphere-only counterpart of `esm-scen7-h`. All forcings evolve as in `esm-scen7-h`, with time-evolving monthly sea-surface temperatures and sea ice prescribed from the model's own `esm-scen7-h` simulation. Models with emissions that depend on the sea-surface state (e.g. DMS) should also prescribe these from the same simulation.
